# Consolidated Project: Event-Driven Price Tracker

### Project Overview
- **Project Name:** Event-driven price tracker
- **Role:** Personal project (solo side project)
- **Business Domain:** Personal side project — not affiliated with any employer.
- **Integrated Tech Stack:** Python, Apache Kafka (message / event pipeline)
- **Note on Kafka:** This project is the *only* place Kafka appears in Sample Dev's
